purpose: Source conditional physical-cue D/E visibility in a q-centered crop; query-pixel target membership is not the target label.
canonical_native8_correspondence: UNKNOWN; nearest old source q row is GT lineage only, no semantic identity input.

label_contract.D: RGB-observed frozen operational cue plus conservative source ownership sanity, entire frozen uncertainty bbox available in crop. Conditional AI teacher, not human gold.
label_contract.E: The same admitted cue was D in original RGB; a known distinct opaque source object is pasted in front and its replayed alpha covers the entire frozen uncertainty footprint; crop remains FULL.
label_contract.self_occlusion_supervision: Unsupported/UNKNOWN; no manufactured S labels or geometry dependence.
label_contract.nonFULL_underlying_reference_state: Preserve D/E reference evidence separately while training_target=U.

model.frozen_backbone: Existing full-image FrozenYoloFeatures P3 extraction, frozen original checkpoint/code/preprocessing; new actual RGB composites need a fresh forward and cache.
model.P3_input: N,65,9,9 = 64 frozen P3 features + binary native input-valid channel; ROI sites q+(i-4)*L/9, continuous+nearest validity per existing source API.
model.RGB_input: N,3,96,96 raw uint8 actual input raster; N,1,96,96 crop_valid. Small learned 4->8->16->16 stride2 RGB+valid branch; interpolate to9x9.
model.geometry_input: query_xy,box_xyxy,side_L only; relative box endpoints /L clipped[-8,8]/8. No image, source, target, row or slot ID token.
model.fusion: P3/nativevalid + learned localRGB + inputvalid fraction + native9 offsets + input-only relative box; conv32 shared feature.
explicit_limits: Binary head is not a trained U/MISS rejection classifier.
A negative D/E-conditional score does not establish a causal E in unknown/other-task deployment inputs.
Localization is coarse native9 auxiliary, not PnP/pose optimization or guaranteed pixel-accurate r.
No reference association or learnability guarantee is created by these inputs.
model.old_feature_reuse: Old q0 P3 arrays cannot stand in for new q/L crops or changed composites. Full-image extraction API/checkpoint may be reused only with correctly indexed actual new image/ROI features.

loss_proposal.class: Unweighted knownFULL D/E BCE mean within each informative source, then equal mean over informative sources.
loss_proposal.heatmap: D-only uncertainty-rectangle area-overlap target on9x9 crop cells; normalized unit mass, source-equal mean CE. E/U heatmaps unknown and masked, never zero-negative.
loss_proposal.absent_source_behavior: Exclude domains with no eligible rows from that term; all-U batch returns exact differentiable zero.
loss_proposal.no_extra_pair_regularizer: Pair preservation is measured; no new pair-loss hyperparameter in this single candidate.
loss_proposal.normalization_note: Class and D-heatmap terms have different informative denominators, explicitly reported; no claim of generic twice-weighted class loss.

prefit_selection_proposal.criterion: For each fixed VAL source/cue, mean unweighted BCE over FULL knownD/E rows. Mean across cues within each VAL source, then macro across VAL sources that have informative rows.
prefit_selection_proposal.checkpoint: Earliest strict minimum at root-frozen fixed validation intervals; last-equal does not replace first minimum.
prefit_selection_proposal.training_budget_seed_batch_optimizer: To be fixed once in root FIT_PROTOCOL before fit; no candidate/threshold search from current223.
prefit_selection_proposal.reused_VAL: Three YCB reference cues were already visually inspected. This is small reused source diagnostic validation, not fresh generalization or human/native8 gold.

fixed_source_evaluation.threshold: logit_D_given_DE>=0 is D; <0 is conditional E. No threshold tuning.
fixed_source_evaluation.primary_cohort: FULL knownD/E conditional teacher only; class confusion GT[D,E] x pred[D,E], D/E precision/recall and per-cue NLL.
fixed_source_evaluation.all_denominators: Report all rows, FULL/PARTIAL/MISS/invalid and each sourceunknown/partialcover/locU count; never drop unknowns from reporting.
fixed_source_evaluation.paired: At identical cue/q/L/box, originalD->fullcoverE both-correct and originalD->neutralD retention; partialcover remains U with output distribution only.
fixed_source_evaluation.query_offset: GT-only max(abs((q-r)/L)) bins [0,.125],(.125,.25],(.25,.5],>.5, fixed before scores; availability remains separate.
fixed_source_evaluation.unknown: Report finite input-valid raw D/E prediction counts by U reason and crop availability, no fabricated unknown accuracy.
fixed_source_evaluation.localization: For knownD, report native9 peak/expected-location error relative to r and uncertainty bbox; coarse target-cell resolution must be shown. E/U localization has no visible-reference target metric.
fixed_source_evaluation.physical_pixel_comparison: If fixed v61/v70/pixel baselines are available, preserve their labels/results and compare only on an explicit same-query semantic mapping. Do not rename pixel presence as cue D/E evidence.
fixed_source_evaluation.old_quality_gates: Leave all historical pixel quality gates/results unchanged; new semantic-cue metrics neither overwrite them nor prove the full native8 goal solved.
fixed_source_evaluation.source_admission: No automatic current/deployment gate; root must separately seal once-selected checkpoint and input contracts if future use is authorized.

leakage_and_integrity_guards: Input-only model NPZ/tensor whitelist; GT-only reference/alpha/cue identity in a separate adapter used only by losses/evaluation.
Freeze data recipe, all source input/RGB/GT/cache SHA, helper/model/trainer SHA, thresholds, selection criterion and fixed update budget before optimizer step.
Group splits by original source scene/target/cue and donor lineage. Keep original/full/partial/neutral variants of each group in the same source split.
Preserve all frozen proposals and source-U labels; reject supervised D/E conflict on identical decoded RGB+q/L/box or effective crop/valid/q/L/box input.
No current223 RGB/features/labels/scores; SHA denylist may be used only for exclusion.
No PnP/GT pose updates or reference-to-input injection. No query recentering or L expansion from referenceGT.
Inference must finish and seal scores before GT evaluation. SourceVAL exposure and limited cue counts remain explicit.
execution_dependencies: New full-image P3 cache on actual new RGB + exact q/L ROI sampling is required (not available in this code-only task).
A root trainer must map immutable metadata to class labels/GT-only heatmap targets while forwarding only input whitelist tensors.
Root must freeze actual source manifests and fit protocol before a single fit.
